archetypes.name: dyn-pause-provenance
archetypes.rationale: Checks the pause snapshot include/exclude boundary that unblocks Step 5c resumes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design-log publish path and pause-load tests for provenance correctness. Focus on whether only pause snapshots retain top-level `.completed/`, whether final logs still exclude it, and whether restored sentinels are sufficient for Step 5c without synthesizing state. Also check legacy snapshots with partial sentinels still downgrade safely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
